title: Snake with sparkly eyes
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- body: sinuous snake shape -->
  <path d="M20 75 Q10 70 12 60 Q16 48 28 50 Q40 52 44 42 Q48 32 60 35 Q72 38 74 28 Q76 18 86 20" 
        fill='none' stroke='#2ecc40' stroke-width='10' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <!-- lighter belly highlight along body -->
  <path d="M20 75 Q10 70 12 60 Q16 48 28 50 Q40 52 44 42 Q48 32 60 35 Q72 38 74 28 Q76 18 86 20" 
        fill='none' stroke='#7cfc00' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='88' cy='19' rx='10' ry='8' fill='#2ecc40'/>
  <!-- head lighter top -->
  <ellipse cx='88' cy='16' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#7cfc00' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- tongue -->
  <path d="M97 19 L102 17 M97 19 L102 21" stroke='#ff4d6d' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='96' y1='19' x2='99' y2='19' stroke='#ff4d6d' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- eye left with sparkle -->
  <circle cx='85' cy='16' r='3' fill='#1a1a2e'/>
  <circle cx='85' cy='16' r='2' fill='#ffcc00'/>
  <circle cx='84.2' cy='15.2' r='0.9' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='86' cy='17' r='0.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- eye right with sparkle -->
  <circle cx='92' cy='16' r='3' fill='#1a1a2e'/>
  <circle cx='92' cy='16' r='2' fill='#ffcc00'/>
  <circle cx='91.2' cy='15.2' r='0.9' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='93' cy='17' r='0.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- sparkle stars around eyes -->
  <path d="M78 10 L79 12 L81 12 L79.5 13.5 L80.5 15.5 L78.5 14.2 L76.5 15.5 L77.5 13.5 L76 12 L78 12 Z" fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.9'/>
  <path d="M98 9 L99 11 L101 11 L99.5 12.5 L100.5 14.5 L98.5 13.2 L96.5 14.5 L97.5 12.5 L96 11 L98 11 Z" fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.9'/>
  <path d="M88 8 L88.8 9.5 L90.5 9.5 L89.2 10.8 L89.8 12.5 L88.2 11.4 L86.6 12.5 L87.2 10.8 L86 9.5 L87.7 9.5 Z" fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- nostrils -->
  <circle cx='95' cy='17.5' r='0.7' fill='#1b7a24'/>
  <circle cx='96' cy='18' r='0.7' fill='#1b7a24'/>
  <!-- body pattern spots -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='48' r='2' fill='#1b7a24' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='40' r='2' fill='#1b7a24' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='65' cy='33' r='1.8' fill='#1b7a24' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='22' cy='62' r='1.8' fill='#1b7a24' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='55' r='1.6' fill='#1b7a24' opacity='0.7'/>
</svg>
